_approach: Build-up-and-pause: bar 1 plays the normal groove, then bar 2 opens with a ramping 16th kick run through beat 2, cuts to total silence for a beat and a half, and lands a single kick + clap + crash on the very last 16th before the drop -- the classic trance 'gap before the drop' moment. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
